values.note: A single roadside site, E009 Highline (Edgemere loop), on Highline Road about 1.1 miles from Pine Flats Road (off PA 402). Back-in, max vehicle length 40 ft; site 45 x 40 ft, full sun, with a 275-ft grass driveway at a slight grade; limited to 2 vehicles.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23603 ('Max Vehicle Length: 40', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Grass', 'Driveway Length: 275', 'Site Length: 45', 'Site Width: 40', 'This site is limited to 2 vehicles'), read 2026-10-20

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('requires a permit from the Pennsylvania State Park and Forest Reservation System', 'A permit is always required for this type of camping') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23603 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'), read 2026-10-20; window, noon cutoff and 7-night limit as already recorded from the same DCNR page

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica (permit always required, so fcfs never), 11 months to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site (E009 Highline) with a 40-ft max vehicle length and a 275-ft grass driveway, open year round. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
